name: phdata
description: phData's catalog of coding-agent extensions: plugins packaging phData Toolkit CLI workflows (setup, datasource connection, pipeline generation, synthetic data, Informatica migration) as skills, preflight scripts, and hooks.

plugins.name: toolkit-core
plugins.description: phData Toolkit CLI foundation: install, PATH setup, project init, JDBC connection/datasource configuration

plugins.name: toolkit-pipeline
plugins.description: Dataspec-driven pipeline generation via toolkit agent discovery and pipeline-build: SQL, dbt, or PySpark transforms plus tests and a datagen spec

plugins.name: toolkit-datagen
plugins.description: Synthetic, fake, mock, and test data via toolkit datagen: the agent writes a data spec, the toolkit generates related tables at any volume to CSV or into a database, reproducibly via a seed

plugins.name: informatica-assessment
plugins.description: Assess an Informatica PowerCenter estate with collect etl, ds lineage, and migration plan: dependency-ordered scored migration waves and an inventory, offline-capable, no LLM required

plugins.name: informatica-etl-conversion
plugins.description: Convert Informatica PowerCenter mappings into Snowflake or Databricks pipelines via agent etl-extract, discovery with a grouped human-review queue, and pipeline-build — one migration-plan group at a time, or a small corpus in a single pass
